title: [SEC1] Validate Tailscale UserID field presence and format
description:
Risk: SelfPeer deserialization via custom visitor silently defaults user_id to empty string if the 'Self' key is absent from Tailscale /status response. If Tailscale LocalAPI changes field name or response structure, kithd continues to start (with wrong owner_id), then rejects all auth requests with cryptic 401 errors. No easy way for an operator to diagnose.

Mitigation: Add explicit validation in LocalApiClient::status() to distinguish between 'missing Self field' (user not logged in, clear error) and 'Self field present but UserID missing' (Tailscale API change, also clear). Log a distinct warning for each case.
